business_problem: centralize data from acquired businesses so pricing, margin, and sales decisions could be based on trusted analytics instead of scattered systems and manual reporting.
solution_summary: Jeld-Wen uses Snowflake and Tableau to centralize data from more than 35 systems and turn pricing, margin, and sales reporting into a governed analytics workflow. Data from acquired businesses across the U.K., France, Sweden, Norway, and Finland is consolidated in Snowflake, where the team built a margin data model that itemizes costs and highlights market, customer, and product performance. Tableau surfaces the modeled data to everyone from sales staff to the CFO and CEO, replacing a harder-to-use QlikView process and giving business users quicker access to trusted figures. Because Snowflake made the core platform easier to scale and manage, the team could focus on smarter pricing strategy, better cost visibility, and wider use of data in day-to-day decisions rather than wrangling disconnected systems.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Centralizes data from dozens of systems and hosts the margin model used for pricing and sales analytics.

solution_components.name: Tableau
solution_components.role: Presents governed dashboards that make pricing, margin, and performance data easy to access across the business.

data_flow: Data from more than 35 systems across acquired European businesses is consolidated in Snowflake, modeled into margin and pricing datasets, and surfaced through Tableau dashboards for sales teams, finance leaders, and executives.
integration_points: European business units in the U.K., France, Sweden, Norway, and Finland
business_outcome: Jeld-Wen created €10 million in incremental revenue, gave the wider business easier access to trusted pricing and margin insight, and reduced operating inefficiencies tied to fragmented data.
architecture_clues: The margin model built in Snowflake itemized material, labor, energy, and overhead costs.
Tableau replaced a QlikView reporting experience that required multiple filters to find the right number.
Snowflake cost controls such as auto-scaling, auto-resume, and auto-suspend helped keep usage efficient.
evidence_quotes: building a margin data model that consolidated more than 35 systems into Snowflake
Snowflake was the backbone that helped us achieve €10 million in revenue
